about: Nothing gets worse (tools/no-regression.py NECESSITY_MAP, docs/MAINTENANCE.md): the tests a person bound to the fingerprinting values they may prove needed. A value main left real that a candidate now disguises (in both sessions, away from the real value) is worse, unless a test bound to it here fails on main and passes on the candidate (each confirmed by running it three times on each side), the candidate changes one of the entry's files, and at most four values are claimed by that test. Nothing else is ever accepted this way. Only a person (or Claude, with the change read in full) edits this file: it is under tests/, so the automatic fix may not touch it and a pull request that changes it never merges by itself; tests.yml reads main's copy. Each entry: "test" (an exact pytest id, tests/test_x.py::test_name), "keys" (observation keys as the report prints them, only the level may be *: fingerprint/*/navigator.hardwareConcurrency), "files" (exact paths under ike/), "why", and who declared it when ("declared").
